Why teams choose HeyGen's AI avatars
HeyGen is built for the videos that grow a business: sales videos, client explainers, course lessons, and social content. Three strengths set it apart from basic avatar makers and generic AI tools.
Get started for free
Presenters people watch to the end
Your AI avatars read as real people on camera, not stiff cartoons or obvious AI. That believability and authenticity is what keeps viewers watching and makes them trust what they hear, so your videos get finished and shared instead of skipped.
Custom avatars, built with consent
Turn a founder, expert, or team member into a custom AI avatar that only appears with their verified permission. Stay on-brand across every video, so the right face represents your business, and you decide exactly where and how it shows up.

Produce a video once, then publish it in 177+ languages and dialects with lip movement matched to each language. There is no reshoot and no per-market vendor, so a single recording reaches every audience you sell to.
Features
The Most Advanced AI Avatar Generator
Create custom AI avatars tailored to your brand, from lifelike models trained on real footage to talking avatars made from a single photo. Here is what the AI avatar generator gives you.
Get started for free
Photo avatars generate realistic AI avatars from a single photo
Upload one front-facing photo and the
AI photo avatar
tool turns that headshot into a talking avatar that speaks your script with natural expression. It is the fastest way to make an AI avatar when you have no footage yet, and you can swap the look anytime.
Try it now
Stock avatars 1,100+ AI presenters ready to use
Not ready to appear yourself? Browse a library of 1,100+ diverse AI avatars across ages, looks, and styles, then assign your script and press generate. Every avatar is camera-ready and cleared for commercial use, so you can cast the right presenter for any audience in a few clicks.
Try it now
Script to video AI generation
Paste a script, upload a PDF, or drop in a link, and the
AI video generator
handles the avatar, voice, and rendering from end-to-end. A 90-second script becomes a finished video in about two minutes, with lip sync matched to every word, so you create video without a camera or crew.
Try it now
Your own custom AI avatar
Record one short video and HeyGen builds your own custom AI avatar that looks and moves like you. It has the same face, micro-expressions, and presence from a 30-second clip to a full-length module, syncs your lips at the phoneme level, and gives you wide, medium, and close-up shots in any outfit or setting from that single recording.
Try it now
Your voice, recreated with your permission
Recreate your voice from a short sample, only with your permission, so your avatar sounds like you in every video. Prefer not to use your own? Pick from 300+ ready-made voices in natural tones, and have your avatar speak in other languages with delivery that still matches the moment.
Try it now
Use Cases
Create Videos With AI Avatars
Get started for free
Short-form personal brand videos
Publish daily without filming daily. Make vertical 9:16 videos with AI avatars for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts, add auto subtitles, and keep your feed active with an influencer generator built for content creators.
Real estate listing and update videos
Every listing needs a video, and every week needs a market update. Turn property details into a walkthrough your avatar presents, then send neighborhood guides and price-change alerts that keep buyers engaged.
Course lessons that build authority
Coaches and course creators live on trust. Put a consistent face on every lesson, and voice cloning carries your delivery across each module, so your content creation keeps moving as you build out the curriculum.
Client explainers for advisors
Financial advisors and attorneys explain complex topics all day. Turn a brief into a clear explainer your avatar delivers on screen, so clients get consistent answers to common questions and you reclaim your time.
Localized videos your clients understand
Your clients do not all speak one language. Generate the same avatar video in 177+ languages and dialects with the video translator, so you show up in each market while still sounding like you.
Product videos, ads, and demos
Small teams cannot reshoot an ad for every angle. Spin up product demos, video ads, and UGC-style promos with your AI avatar, test new hooks, and turn one script into a personalized video that sells.
Personalized sales and outreach videos
Generic outreach gets ignored. Record once, then send personalized sales videos where your AI spokesperson greets each prospect by name, so outreach keeps running while you focus on closing.
Webinars and long-form training
A full webinar or masterclass is a production in itself. Deliver a 40-minute session or an evergreen training with your avatar, then update any part later by editing the script instead of starting over.
How it works
How to create your own AI avatar
Go from script to a finished AI avatar video in four steps.
Choose your avatar
Pick a ready-made avatar or create your own avatar with AI from a photo or short video.
Add your script
Paste a script, upload a PDF, or type a prompt, then pick a voice for your avatar.
Generate your video
Press generate, and HeyGen renders a high-quality avatar video in minutes, lip-sync included.
Export and share
Download in the sizes you need or share a link directly — square, vertical, and widescreen included.
AI avatar generator FAQs
What is an AI avatar generator?
An AI avatar generator is a tool that creates digital presenters using artificial intelligence. It can turn a script into a video of a realistic or animated avatar speaking the text, with generated voice, lip sync, facial expressions, and body movements. This lets you create presenter-led videos without filming a real person.
What is the best AI avatar generator?
HeyGen is the best AI avatar generator because it leads on all four things that matter. Avatar realism. Library size: 1,100+ stock avatars. Custom avatars built from your own footage. Language coverage: 177+ languages and dialects. Most tools do one or two of these well. HeyGen does all four, which is why it holds a 4.8 on G2 across 1,000+ reviews.
How do I create an AI avatar of myself?
Two ways. Record about 30 seconds to camera and HeyGen builds a custom avatar with your face, expressions, and delivery. Or upload one front-facing photo for a faster result. No design or editing skills needed. If you publish weekly, bulk generation turns a spreadsheet of scripts into finished videos in one run. Custom avatars require verified consent from the person being recreated.
Which type of HeyGen avatar is right for me?
Use a stock avatar for speed, a
Photo avatars
to animate a single image, or a
Custom avatars
when you want the presenter to look like you. Most teams start with stock, then switch to custom for more personalized content.
Where can I find AI avatars for social media, marketing, or personal use?
HeyGen and similar platforms create talking-head videos for social posts, YouTube Shorts, UGC ads, and website spokespersons without filming. Pick a stock avatar or clone yourself, paste a script, get a lip-synced video. Save your avatar and voice as presets to stay consistent across channels.
Can AI avatars speak multiple languages and lip-sync accurately?
Yes. HeyGen supports 177+ languages and dialects, translating your video while syncing the avatar’s lip movements to the new audio. You can also use your cloned voice across supported languages, turning one recording into localized versions for different audiences.
How much can you customize HeyGen AI avatars?
HeyGen lets you customize an avatar’s clothing, background, voice, gestures, and expressions. You can also control gaze, posture, movement, and overall energy with simple text instructions, without manually animating each action.
Can I use HeyGen AI avatar videos commercially?
Yes, on eligible paid plans. You can use HeyGen videos for ads, marketing, social media, and client work. Stock avatars are cleared for generated videos, and you can commercially use custom avatars you create if you have the necessary rights and consent.
Is it safe to create a custom AI avatar with HeyGen?
Yes. A custom HeyGen avatar is created with your consent and is tied to your workspace. HeyGen does not make your custom avatar available for other users to use. You control where and how it is used.
HeyGen also moderates content and follows strong security and privacy standards, including
SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliance
.
